  - 'NONE': The VOLCOUNT parameter is not passed to DFSMSdss and DFSMShsm operates as it did prior to the VOLCOUNT support being added where the source volume count must be maintained. 
 If you do not specify SETSYS ABARSVOLCOUNT, the default is NONE. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-abarsvolcount-specifying-method-determining-volume-count-sms-target-data-set-allocations-done-by-dfsmsdss

arecover_ml2_unit_name.description:
(ARECOVERML2UNIT(unittype)) specifies the type of tape unit to use in a nonspecific volume request when recovering migrated data sets to ML2 tape volumes. If you do not specify this parameter, the DFSMShsm default is 3590-1. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-arecoverml2unit-specifying-unit-when-recovering-migrated-data-sets-nonspecific-volumes

arecover_percent_utilized.description:
(ARECOVERPERCENTUTILIZED(nnn)) is an optional parameter that allows you to change the percentage to which DFSMShsm allows DFSMSdss to fill non-SMS-managed DASD recovery volumes. For nnn, it is an integer number between 1 and 100. If you do not specify this parameter on any SETSYS command, the DFSMShsm default is 80% (80). 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-arecoverpercentutilized-specifying-percentage-dasd-space-non-sms-managed-volumes

arecover_target_gds_status.description:
(ARECOVERTGTGDS) is used to pass TGTGDS parameter to DFSMSdss during restore processing including: 
  - 'DEFERRED': specifies that the target data set is to be assigned the DEFERRED status. 
  - 'ACTIVE': specifies that the target data set is to be assigned the ACTIVE status, for example, rolled into the GDG base. 
  - 'ROLLEDOFF': specifies that the target data set is to be assigned the ROLLEDOFF status. 
  - 'SOURCE': specifies that the target data set is to be assigned the same status as that of the source data set. 
 The default is SOURCE. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-arecovertgtgds-passing-tgtgds-parameter-dfsmsdss-during-restore-processing

arecover_unit_name.description:
(ARECOVERUNITNAME(unittype)) is an optional parameter specifying the tape unit type for data sets being recovered to user tape volumes during an aggregate recovery. If you do not specify unittype the default is 3590-1. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-arecoverunitname-specifying-tape-unit-type-aggregate-recovery

max_abars_address_space.description:
(MAXABARSADDRESSSPACE(nn)) is an optional parameter specifying the maximum number of concurrent aggregate backup and recovery address spaces that DFSMShsm supports. For nn, it is a decimal number from 1 to 64 to represent the number of secondary address spaces that can run concurrently for aggregate backup and recovery. If you do not specify this parameter on any SETSYS command, the DFSMShsm default is one. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxabarsaddressspace-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-secondary-address-spaces-supported

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: Defining media information: MEDINF
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description: Use the MEDINF command to define media characteristics for OEM media products.

name.title: Media information name : NAME(name)
name.description: Specifies a name for the media information. Specify a value between 1 and 8 alphanumeric characters.

media_type.title: Media type specification : MEDIATYPE(mediatype_id,mediatype_name)
media_type.description: Use this operand to identify the internally-used mediatype_id to be converted to the externally-used mediatype_name.

mediatype_id.description: mediatype_id is a number in the range from 1 to 255.

mediatype_name.description: mediatype_name is 1 to 8 alphanumeric or national characters.

recording_format.title: Recording format specification : RECORDINGFORMAT(recordingformat_id,recordingformat_name)
recording_format.description: Use this operand to identify the internally-used recordingformat_id to be converted to the externally-used recordingformat_name.

recordingformat_id.description: recordingformat_id is a number in the range from 1 to 255.

recordingformat_name.description: recordingformat_name is 1 to 8 alphanumeric or national characters.

capacity.title: Media capacity in MB : CAPACITY(capacity)
capacity.description: Specifies the media capacity in MB available on the non-IBM media. Specify a value from 0 to 4294967295.

replace.title: Replacement criteria for media : REPLACE(PERM|TEMP|AGE|WMC)
replace.description: Use this operand to identify the policies for replacement of volumes.

perm_count.title: REPLACE(PERM(perm_count))
perm_count.description: Policy based on permanent I/O errors. Value range 0 to 99999.

temp_count.title: REPLACE(TEMP(temp_count))
temp_count.description: Policy based on temporary I/O errors. Value range 0 to 99999.

age_years.title: REPLACE(AGE(age_years))
age_years.description: Policy based on the age of the volume. Value range 0 to 99999.

wmc_count.title: REPLACE(WMC(wmc_count))
wmc_count.description: Policy based on how many times the volume is mounted for output. Valid value range 0 to 65535.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: Defining mount and fetch messages: MNTMSG
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description: Use the MNTMSG command to tailor mount and fetch messages so they display the volume serial number, rack number, and pooling decision.

message_id.title: Message ID : MSGID(nnnnnnnnnnnn)
message_id.description: Specifies message text 1 to 12 characters long. Normally the text is the message number, but it can include additional characters and blanks.

id.title: ID : ID(nnn)
id.description: Specifies the starting position of the message identifier. Specify a value between 1 and 128, or 999.

rack.title: RACK : RACK(nnn | 999)
rack.description: Specifies the position to insert the rack number, pool prefix, pool name, or storage group in the message.

volume.title: Volume : VOLUME(nnn)
volume.description: Specifies the position of the volume serial number in the message. Specify a value between 1 and 128.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description: Data Management Definitions for z/OS V3R1

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: DFSMShsm ARCCMDxx SETSYS commands for event-driven migrations
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description:
(SETSYS) DFSMShsm SETSYS parameters that controlling event-driven migrations including both Interval migration and On-demand migration, including: 
  - event_driven_migration_quiesce_time 
  - interval_migration 
  - max_concurrent_migration_tasks 
  - on_demand_migration 
  -  on_demand_migration_notification_limit

event_driven_migration_quiesce_time.description:
(EVENTDRIVENMIGRATIONQUIESCE) Specifying quiesce window(s) for Interval and On-demand Migration. The times defined as: 
  - 'hour_minute_1' is the quiesce start time of the first window. 
  - 'hour_minute_2' is the quiesce end time of the first window. 
  - 'hour_minute_3' is the quiesce start time of the second window. 
  - 'hour_minute_4' is the quiesce start time of the second window. 
 Specific Notes: 
  - To reset the time windows, specify all hhmm(s) in the first window only as 0000 (for example, 'EVENTDRIVENMIGRATIONQUIESCE(0000 0000)'). Specifying any other combination of 0000 will result in a parse error and neither of the time windows being reset simultaneously. 
  - Time windows cannot overlap (for example, 'EVENTDRIVENMIGRATIONQUIESCE(1315 0430 0400 0800)').  
  - Start and end times within a window, and within a set of windows, cannot be equal to the exception of specifying 0000 (as noted in the first note) in the first time window. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-eventdrivenmigrationquiesce-specifying-quiesce-windows-interval-demand-migration

first_window_start_time.description:
(hhmm1) is the quiesce start time of the first window. Time is based on the 24-hour clock and is expressed as a four-digit decimal number in the format hhmm. 
 The maximum value you can specify for hh is 24, the maximum value you can specify for mm is 59, and the maximum value you can specify for hhmm is 2400.

first_window_end_time.description:
(hhmm2) is the quiesce end time of the first window. Time is based on the 24-hour clock and is expressed as a four-digit decimal number in the format hhmm. 
 The maximum value you can specify for hh is 24, the maximum value you can specify for mm is 59, and the maximum value you can specify for hhmm is 2400.

second_window_start_time.description:
(hhmm3) is the quiesce start time of the second window. Time is based on the 24-hour clock and is expressed as a four-digit decimal number in the format hhmm. 
 The maximum value you can specify for hh is 24, the maximum value you can specify for mm is 59, and the maximum value you can specify for hhmm is 2400.

second_window_end_time.description:
(hhmm4) is the quiesce end time of the second window. Time is based on the 24-hour clock and is expressed as a four-digit decimal number in the format hhmm. 
 The maximum value you can specify for hh is 24, the maximum value you can specify for mm is 59, and the maximum value you can specify for hhmm is 2400.

interval_migration.description:
(INTERVALMIGRATION | NOINTERVALMIGRATION) Specifying whether interval migration is performed. 
  - true: (INTERVALMIGRATION) the interval migration is performed. 
  - false: (NOINTERVALMIGRATION) the interval migration is not performed. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-intervalmigration-nointervalmigration-specifying-whether-interval-migration-is-performed

max_tasks_event_driven_migration.description:
(MAXEVENTDRIVENMIGTASKS | MAXINTERVALTASKS) Specifying the maximum number of automatic interval migration or on-demand migration tasks that can run concurrently (0-15). 
 If you do not specify this parameter on any SETSYS command, the default value for the maximum number of concurrent interval migration or on-demand migration tasks (nn) is equal to the value defined for MAXMIGRATIONTASKS. The default value for MAXMIGRATIONTASKS is 2.
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxintervaltasks-specifying-maximum-number-automatic-interval-migration-demand-migration-tasks-that-can-run-concurrently

on_demand_migration.description:
(ONDEMANDMIGRATION) Specifying whether on-demand migration should be performed.  
  - true: (Y) On-demand migration is performed. 
 - false: (N) On-demand migration is not performed. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-ondemandmigration-specifying-whether-demand-migration-should-be-performed

on_demand_migration_notification_limit.description:
(ODMNOTIFICATIONLIMIT) Specifying an on-demand migration number of concurrently queued volumes notification limit (1 to 99999). If you do not specify ODMNOTIFICATIONLIMIT on the SETSYS command during startup, the default limit is 100. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-odmnotificationlimit-specifying-demand-migration-number-concurrently-queued-volumes-notification-limit

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: DFSMShsm ARCCMDxx SETSYS commands for recall function
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description:
(SETSYS) DFSMShsm SETSYS parameters controlling the recall environment. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=dsar-setsys-command-establishing-changing-values-dfsmshsm-control-parameters
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.$comment:
(RECALL) Defining parameters and subparameters affecting DFSMShsm recall function. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-setsys-fast-path-dfsmshsm-functions

max_tasks_recall.description:
(MAXRECALLTASKS) Controlling the recall environment. MAXRECALLTASKS(max_tasks)is an optional parameter specifying the maximum number of active recall tasks DFSMShsm can concurrently process. For max_tasks, substitute with a decimal number from 1 to 15 to represent the number of concurrent recall tasks DFSMShsm can process. The default is 15 tasks. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-maxrecalltasks-specifying-maximum-number-active-recall-tasks

max_tasks_recall_from_tape.description:
(TAPEMAXRECALLTASKS) Controlling the recall from tape environment. TAPEMAXRECALLTASKS(max_tasks)is an optional parameter specifying the maximum number of recall tasks that can concurrently request tape mounts. For max_tasks, substitute with a decimal number from 1 to 15. The value you specify must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to the value you specify with the MAXRECALLTASKS parameter. TAPEMAXRECALLTASKS is a subset of the MAXRECALLTASKS parameter. When TAPEMAXRECALLTASKS(max_tasks) is not specified, the default is 1 tape recall task. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-tapemaxrecalltasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-tape-recall-tasks

recall_time_limits_mounted_ml2_tapes.description:
(TAPERECALLLIMITS) is an optional parameter specifying the total time that a recall task can utilize a single tape mount for processing recall requests before criteria is used to possibly demount the tape. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-taperecalllimits-specifying-limits-continuously-mounted-ml2-tapes-during-multiple-recalls

task_time_limit.description:
(TASK(minutes)) Allows you to specify the number of minutes that a DFSMShsm recall task can process recall requests from a single tape mount before DFSMShsm decides whether to demount the tape or to continue processing. If you do not specify TASK(minutes), the default time used is 15 minutes. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-taperecalllimits-specifying-limits-continuously-mounted-ml2-tapes-during-multiple-recalls

tape_time_limit.description:
(TAPE(minutes)) Allows you to specify the number of minutes that a recall task can process recalls from a single tape mount before additional criteria are considered. If you do not TAPE(minutes), the default time used is 20 minutes for TAPE. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-taperecalllimits-specifying-limits-continuously-mounted-ml2-tapes-during-multiple-recalls

conversion_recall_recover.descriptions:
(CONVERSION | NOCONVERSION | CONVERSION(...)) Specifying whether DFSMShsm reblocks eligible data sets during recall or recovery. This parameter is not applicable to system-reblockable data sets, whether they are SMS or non-SMS. 
 If true (CONVERSION), DFSMShsm can reblock the data sets during recall or recovery. 
 If false (NOCONVERSION), DFSMShsm will not reblock the data sets even if you specified the data set reblock exit. If object (CONVERSION(...)), use the available properties to fine tune how DFSMShsm will reblock data sets during recall or recovery. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-conversion-noconversion-specifying-whether-reblocking-is-occur

reblock_to_any.description:
(REBLOCKTOANY) is an optional subparameter of the CONVERSION parameter. If true (CONVERSION(REBLOCKING)), it specifies reblocking to any DASD device type supported by DFSMShsm. If false, (CONVERSION) is in effect. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-conversion-noconversion-specifying-whether-reblocking-is-occur

recall_volume_type.description:
(RECALL | RECALL(...)) Specifying where DFSMShsm puts the non-SMS-managed recalled data sets. 
 If true (RECALL) is specified without a subparameter, or if this RECALL parameter is not specified, the default is RECALL(ANYSTORAGEVOLUME). If object (RECALL(...)), use the available properties to fine tune how DFSMShsm will put the non-SMS-managed recalled data sets. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-recall-specifying-target-volume-receive-recalled-data-sets

any_storage_volume.description:
(ANYSTORAGEVOLUME) DFSMShsm recalls a data set to an online primary volume with the use attribute of storage and the primary volume attribute of automatic recall. If true, (ANYSTORAGEVOLUME) is specified without a subparameter, the default is ANYSTORAGEVOLUME(LIKE). 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-recall-specifying-target-volume-receive-recalled-data-sets

device_characteristics_any_volume.description:
(LIKE|UNLIKE) An optional subparameter that specifies whether DFSMShsm recall to volumes with matched device attributes. 
 (LIKE) During undirected recall, only primary volumes whose primary volume attributes match the attributes of the primary volume that the data set migrated from are considered as possible target volumes for the recall. (UNLIKE) During undirected recall, volumes whose currently specified primary volume attributes do not match those of the source primary volume are eligible for selection. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-recall-specifying-target-volume-receive-recalled-data-sets

private_volume.description:
(PRIVATEVOLUME) DFSMShsm recalls a data set to any online primary volume with the use attribute of public, storage, or private and the primary volume attribute of automatic recall. If true, (PRIVATEVOLUME) is specified without a subparameter, the default is PRIVATEVOLUME(LIKE).  
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-recall-specifying-target-volume-receive-recalled-data-sets

device_characteristics_private_volume.description:
(LIKE|UNLIKE) An optional subparameter that specifies whether DFSMShsm recall to volumes with matched device attributes. 
 (LIKE) During undirected recall, only primary volumes whose primary volume attributes match the attributes of the primary volume that the data set migrated from are considered as possible target volumes for the recall. (UNLIKE) During undirected recall, volumes whose currently specified primary volume attributes do not match those of the source primary volume are eligible for selection. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-recall-specifying-target-volume-receive-recalled-data-sets

volume_count_recall_recover.description:
(VOLCOUNT(ANY|NONE)) is an optional parameter that affects how DFSMShsm will invoke DFSMSdss for the recall and recover of data sets moved by DFSMSdss. 
 (VOLCOUNT(ANY)) specifies DFSMShsm passes the VOLCOUNT(ANY) parameter to DFSMSdss during the recall or recover of data moved by DFSMSdss. This results in the allocation of the target data set on as many volumes as required, to a maximum of 59. 
 (VOLCOUNT(NONE)) specifies the VOLCOUNT parameter is not passed to DFSMSdss. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-volcount-specifying-method-determining-volume-count-sms-target-data-set-allocations-when-performed-by-dfsmsdss

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: DFSMShsm ARCCMDxx SETSYS commands for fast replication functions
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description:
(SETSYS) Parameters controlling the fast replication environment. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=dsar-setsys-command-establishing-changing-values-dfsmshsm-control-parameters
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.$comment:
(FASTREPLICATION) Defining parameters and subparameters affecting DFSMShsm fast replication functions. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-setsys-fast-path-dfsmshsm-functions

fast_replication.description:
(FASTREPLICATION) Controlling the fast replication environment. FASTREPLICATION is an optional parameter that specifies which copy method to use for data set recovery and other options. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-fastreplication-specifying-fast-replication-methods

dataset_recovery.description:
(DATASETRECOVERY(method)) is an optional parameter that specifies whether fast replication should be used for data set recovery from copy pool backups. For method, substitue with NONE, PREFERRED, or REQUIRED. When DATASETRECOVERY(method) is not specified, the default is to use traditional copy methods and fast replication is not used (NONE). 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-fastreplication-specifying-fast-replication-methods

flashcopy_relationship_level.description:
(FCRELATION(level)) is an optional parameter that specifies whether extent-level or full-volume-level FlashCopy relationships are to be established for fast replication backup and recovery of volumes. When FCRELATION(level) is not specified, the default is to establish extent-level FlashCopy relationships (EXTENT). 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-fastreplication-specifying-fast-replication-methods

message_dataset.description:
(MESSAGEDATASET(YES|NO HLQ(hlq))) is an optional parameter that specifies messages for each fast replication command or automatic dump of a copy pool should be directed to a unique fast replication message data set. When MESSAGEDATASET(YES|NO) is not specified, the default is to not direct messages to a fast replication message data set (NO). 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-fastreplication-specifying-fast-replication-methods

use_unique_message_dataset.description:
Specify YES to direct messages for each fast replication command to a unique message data set. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-fastreplication-specifying-fast-replication-methods

high_level_qualifier.description:
(HLQ(hlq)) sepecifies the high level qualifer for the message data set. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-fastreplication-specifying-fast-replication-methods
high_level_qualifier.$comment: The high-level-qualifier value (hlq) may be specified in lowercase, uppercase, or mixed case.

volume_pair_messages.description:
(VOLUMEPAIRMESSAGES(YES|NO)) is an optional parameter that controls FlashCopy volume pairing debug message ARC1809I. If you don't specify VOLUMEPAIRMESSAGES, the default is to disable ARC1809I messages (NO). 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-fastreplication-specifying-fast-replication-methods

max_tasks_copypool_fast_replication.description:
(MAXCOPYPOOLTASKS) Controlling the fast replication environment. MAXCOPYPOOLTASKS is an optional parameter that allows you to define the maximum number of DFSMSdss invocations for each fast replication command that DFSMShsm can process concurrently. FRBACKUP tasks: The maximum number of concurrent fast replication backup volume tasks is the product of the FRBACKUP and DSS parameters. FRRECOV tasks: The maximum number of concurrent fast replication recover volume tasks is the product of the FRRECOV and DSS parameters. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxcopypooltasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-dfsmsdss-invocations-each-fast-replication-command

fr_backup_tasks.description:
(FRBACKUP(max_tasks)) is an optional parameter that you specify to define the maximum number of DFSMSdss invocations for each FRBACKUP command. For max_tasks, substitue with a decimal number from 1 to 64 to represent the number of DFSMSdss invocations. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxcopypooltasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-dfsmsdss-invocations-each-fast-replication-command

fr_recover_tasks.description:
(FRRECOV(max_tasks)) is an optional parameter that you specify to define the maximum number of DFSMSdss invocations for each FRRECOV command. For max_tasks, substitue with a decimal number from 1 to 64 to represent the number of DFSMSdss invocations. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxcopypooltasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-dfsmsdss-invocations-each-fast-replication-command

dss_copy_pairs.description:
(DSS(max_volume_pairs)) is an optional parameter that you specify to define the maximum number of volume pairs that DFSMShsm passes to each DFSMSdss invocation for backup and recover functions. For max_volume_pairs, substitue with a decimal number from 1 to 254 to represent the number of volume pairs. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxcopypooltasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-dfsmsdss-invocations-each-fast-replication-command

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: Defining system options: OPTION
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description: Use the OPTION command to define the installation options for DFSMSrmm. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=guide-defining-system-options-option

control_data_set_id.title: Control Data Set ID : CDSID(ID)
control_data_set_id.description: Specifies the identifier of the control data set that must be used on this system. Specify a value one to eight characters long.

abend_retpd.title: Abend retention period : ABENDRETPD(NONE | nnnnn)
abend_retpd.description: Specifies the retention period in days applied to a volume when a job abends during output. NONE means no special abend retention is applied. Specify 0 to 93000 days.

accounting.title: Accounting information : ACCOUNTING(JOB | STEP)
accounting.description: Specifies whether DFSMSrmm records JOB or STEP accounting information.

backup_proc.title: Backup procedure : BACKUPPROC(proc_name)
backup_proc.description: Specifies the name of the procedure started automatically when the journal percentage full threshold is reached.

bypass_label_processing.title: Bypass label processing : BLP(RMM | NORMM)
bypass_label_processing.description: Specifies how DFSMSrmm controls bypass label processing.

catalog_retention.title: Catalog retention in hours : CATRETPD(12 | ret_hours)
catalog_retention.description: Specifies the number of hours from creation that a data set should be retained if it has not been cataloged.

catalog_system_ids.title: Catalog System ID: CATSYSID(*|,sys_ID_list)
catalog_system_ids.description: Specify CATSYSID to enable DFSMSrmm catalog synchronization.

cds_threshold_percent.title: CDS Threshold Percent : CDSFULL(95 | nn)
cds_threshold_percent.description: Specify CDSFULL to define a percentage full threshold for the CDS data set.

client.title: Client : CLIENT(SERVERNAME(ServerName) PORT(PortNumber))
client.description: Specifies the type of system you want to set up as a client.

server_name.title: SERVERNAME(servername)
server_name.description: The server hostname, IP address, or domain name.

port_number.title: PORT(portnumber)
port_number.description: Specify the port number to be used for IP communication. Specify a value from 1024 to 65535.

command_authorization.title: Type of Authorization : COMMANDAUTH(OWNER | DSN | OWNER,DSN)
command_authorization.description: Specifies the type of authorization that DFSMSrmm is to check.

date_format.title: Date format : DATEFORM(AMERICAN | EUROPEAN | ISO | JULIAN)
date_format.description: Specifies the date format for messages and reports.

defaults_table_suffix.title: Defaults Table : DEFTABLE(cc)
defaults_table_suffix.description: Specifies the two-letter suffix for the defaults table in EDGDEFxx.

display_dd_card_name.title: DD Card Name : DISPDDNAME(ddname)
display_dd_card_name.description: Specifies the name of the DD card which identifies the data set containing disposition control statements.

wto_message_number.title: WTO Message Number : DISPMSGID(message_id | EDG4054I)
wto_message_number.description: Specifies the message number that DFSMSrmm uses for write-to-operator messages.

cds_data_set_name.title: DFSMSrmm control Dataset Name : DSNAME(MASTER DD | name)
cds_data_set_name.description: Specifies the name of the DFSMSrmm control data set. Specify a name up to 44 characters long.

prevent_access_of_expired_data_Sets.title: DSNEXPIRE(BLOCK | NONE)
prevent_access_of_expired_data_Sets.description: DSNEXPIRE option allows for blocking access to data sets that are expired.

external_data_management.title: Dynamic setting of the volume EDM attribute : EDM(NO | YES)
external_data_management.description: Controls whether the dynamic setting of the volume EDM attribute occurs.

expdt_maximum_dropped.title: EXPDT maximum dropped : EXPDTDROP((COUNT(count)|PERCENT(%age),action) | PERCENT(10))
expdt_maximum_dropped.description: Specify a maximum number or percentage of existing expiration date retained volumes that can be dropped from retention.

count.title: count (positional)
count.description: Absolute maximum number of volumes that can be released by a single run of EDGHSKP EXPROC processing.

percent.title: PERCENT(%age)
percent.description: Maximum percentage of existing EXPDT-retained volumes that can be released.

action.title: action (positional)
action.description: Controls the action DFSMSrmm takes when the value is exceeded.

vrsel_gdg_options.title: GDG option : GDG(CYCLEBY(GENERATION|CRDATE),DUPLICATE(BUMP|COUNT|DROP|KEEP))
vrsel_gdg_options.description: Use the GDG option to specify how generation data groups are handled for cycle retention by VRSEL processing.

cycle_by.title: CYCLEBY(GENERATION | CRDATE)
cycle_by.description: Specifies whether retention is to be based on generation number or on creation date.

duplicate.title: DUPLICATE(BUMP | COUNT | DROP | KEEP)
duplicate.description: Specifies how VRSEL processing handles duplicate generations.

housekeeping.title: Housekeeping : HSKP(ALL | LIMITED)
housekeeping.description: Specifies whether housekeeping has full or restricted functionality.

boot_date.title: IPL Date : IPLDATE(YES | NO)
boot_date.description: Specifies whether IPL date checking is required.

journal_percentage_threshold.title: Journal Percentage Threshold : JOURNALFULL(75 | nn)
journal_percentage_threshold.description: Specify JOURNALFULL to define a percentage full threshold for the journal data set.

journal_name.title: Journal Name : JRNLNAME(name | JOURNAL DD)
journal_name.description: Specifies the name of the journal. Specify a name up to 44 characters long.

journal_unchanged_copies.title: JRNLTRAN(NO | YES)
journal_unchanged_copies.description: Specifies whether the unchanged copy of a CDS record is journaled as well as the updated copy.

lines_per_page.title: Lines per page : LINECOUNT(54 | nnn)
lines_per_page.description: Specifies the default number of lines per page for reports. Specify a value between 10 and 999.

number_of_local_task.title: Number of local tasks : LOCALTASKS(10 | number)
number_of_local_task.description: Use this operand to set the number of tasks available on each system for processing locally initiated requests.

master_overwrite.title: DFSMSrmm master volume overwrite option : MASTEROVERWRITE(ADD | LAST | MATCH | USER)
master_overwrite.description: Controls how DFSMSrmm allows the overwriting of a volume.

maximum_number_of_records.title: Maximum Number of activities : MAXHOLD(100 | nnn)
maximum_number_of_records.description: Specifies the maximum number of activities DFSMSrmm performs before the reserve is released and reacquired.

maximum_retpd.title: Maximum Retention Period : MAXRETPD(NOLIMIT | nnnnn)
maximum_retpd.description: Specifies the maximum retention period that a user can request for data sets on volumes.

management_class_attributes.title: DFSMS management class : MCATTR(NONE | ALL | VRSELXDI)
management_class_attributes.description: Specifies whether DFSMSrmm should use DFSMS management class expiration attributes.

media_name.title: Media Name : MEDIANAME(3480 | medianame)
media_name.description: Sets a default medianame value that DFSMSrmm uses when you do not specify a media name for a volume.

secondary_edgrmm_suffix.title: Member : MEMBER(parmlib_suffix)
secondary_edgrmm_suffix.description: Identifies a second parmlib member containing overriding or additional parmlib options.

moveby_volumes.title: Move volumes : MOVEBY(SET | VOLUME)
moveby_volumes.description: Specify the MOVEBY operand to move volumes that are retained by DFSMSrmm vital record specifications.

message_mixed_case.title: Message text : MSG(MIXED | UPPER)
message_mixed_case.description: Specify to control the case for message text.

notify_volume_owner.title: Notify volume owner : NOTIFY(NO | YES)
notify_volume_owner.description: Specifies whether to notify the owner when a volume is pending release.

operating_mode.title: Operating mode : OPMODE(R | W | P)
operating_mode.description: Specifies the operating mode for DFSMSrmm. R=Record, W=Warning, P=Protect, M=Manual.

enable_pda_trace.title: PDA trace enable : PDA(ON | OFF)
enable_pda_trace.description: Specifies whether PDA trace is enabled.

pda_block_count.title: PDA block count : PDABLKCT(nnn)
pda_block_count.description: Specifies the number of PDA trace blocks.

pda_blocksize.title: PDA block size : PDABLKSIZE(nn)
pda_blocksize.description: Specifies the size of each PDA trace block in pages.

enable_pda_log.title: PDA log : PDALOG(ON | OFF)
enable_pda_log.description: Specifies whether PDA log is enabled.

activate_pre_acs_option.title: PREACS option : PREACS(YES | NO)
activate_pre_acs_option.description: Specifies whether pre-allocation checking is active.

retain_by.title: Retain by : RETAINBY(SET | VOLUME)
retain_by.description: Specifies how multivolume sets are retained by DFSMSrmm vital record specifications.

retention_method.title: Retention method : RETENTIONMETHOD(EXPDT | VRSEL)
retention_method.description: Specifies how DFSMSrmm determines the retention method for tape volumes.

expdt.title: EXPDT retention method options
expdt.description: Configuration for the EXPDT retention method.

retain_by.title: Retain by : RETAINBY(FIRSTFILE | LASTFILE)
retain_by.description: Specifies which file's expiration date is used.

catlgdays.title: CATLGDAYS(nnn)
catlgdays.description: Specifies the number of days to retain a cataloged volume.

last_referenced.title: Last referenced days : LASTREF(nnn)
last_referenced.description: Specifies the number of days after last reference to retain the volume.

default_retention_period.title: Default retain period : RETPD(nnnnn | PERMANENT)
default_retention_period.description: Specifies the default retention period in days. PERMANENT means no expiration.

reuse_bin.title: Reuse bin : REUSEBIN(CONFIRMMOVE | STARTMOVE)
reuse_bin.description: Specifies when DFSMSrmm reuses bin numbers. CONFIRMMOVE reuses after move is confirmed; STARTMOVE reuses when move starts.

scratch_procedure.title: Scratch procedure : SCRATCHPROC(proc_name)
scratch_procedure.description: Specifies the name of the procedure started when a volume is scratched.

server.title: Server : SERVER(PORT(PortNumber) TASKS(n))
server.description: Specifies the type of system you want to set up as a server.

smf_audit_records.title: SMF audit records : SMFAUD(YES | smf_type_number)
smf_audit_records.description: Enables SMF audit records. YES uses the default SMF type; specify an integer for a custom SMF record type number.

smf_security_records.title: SMF security records : SMFSEC(YES | smf_type_number)
smf_security_records.description: Enables SMF security records. YES uses the default SMF type; specify an integer for a custom SMF record type number.

sms_acs_option.title: SMSACS option : SMSACS(YES | NO)
sms_acs_option.description: Specifies whether DFSMSrmm uses SMSACS for volume selection.

smstape_TCB_update.title: SMSTAPE TCB update : SMSTAPE(UPDATE(...) PURGE(...))
smstape_TCB_update.description: Specifies the SMSTAPE options for TCB update processing.

update.title: UPDATE(EXITS | SCRATCH | COMMAND)
update.description: Specifies which operations trigger SMSTAPE TCB updates.

purge.title: PURGE(YES | NO)
purge.description: Specifies whether to purge SMSTAPE records.

system_name.title: System name : SYSID(name)
system_name.description: Specifies the system identifier for this DFSMSrmm subsystem.

type_of_RACF_tape.title: RACF tape type : TPRACF(NONE | AUTOMATIC | PREDEFINED | CLEANUP)
type_of_RACF_tape.description: Specifies the type of RACF tape support for the entire DFSMSrmm system.

edgtvext_action.title: EDGTVEXT action : TVEXTPURGE(RELEASE | EXPIRE(days) | NONE)
edgtvext_action.description: Specifies the action DFSMSrmm takes when EDGTVEXT is called. RELEASE releases the volume; EXPIRE(days) expires it after the specified number of days; NONE takes no action.

catalog_option.title: Catalog option : UNCATALOG(YES | NO | SCRATCH)
catalog_option.description: Specifies whether DFSMSrmm uncatalogs data sets when a volume is scratched. SCRATCH uncatalogs only when the volume is returned to scratch.

vrs_change_info.title: VRS change info : VRSCHANGE(VERIFY | INFO)
vrs_change_info.description: Specifies the action DFSMSrmm takes when VRS retention changes.

vrs_maximum_dropped.title: VRS maximum dropped : VRSDROP((COUNT(count)|PERCENT(%age),action))
vrs_maximum_dropped.description: Specify a maximum number or percentage of VRS-retained volumes that can be dropped from retention.

vrs_processing.title: VRS processing : VRSEL(NEW | ALL)
vrs_processing.description: Specifies which volumes are considered during VRSEL processing.

vrs_rentention_by_jobname.title: VRS retention by jobname : VRSJOBNAME(1 | 2)
vrs_rentention_by_jobname.description: Specifies how jobname retention is applied during VRSEL processing. 1 = retain first occurrence per jobname; 2 = retain two occurrences per jobname.

vrs_minimum.title: VRS minimum : VRSMIN((COUNT(count)|PERCENT(%age),action))
vrs_minimum.description: Specifies the minimum number or percentage of VRS-retained volumes.

vrs_minimum_retained.title: VRS minimum retained : VRSMINRETAIN((COUNT(count)|PERCENT(%age),action))
vrs_minimum_retained.description: Specifies the minimum number or percentage of volumes to be retained by VRS.

retpd_days_property.description: Retention period in days. Range 0 to 93000.

whilecatalog_property.description: Retention while cataloged. ON=retain while cataloged, OFF=do not retain, UNTILEXPIRED=retain until expiration date, ONLY=retain only while cataloged.

vrs_percent_property.description: Maximum or minimum percentage of volumes. Range 0 to 100.

vrs_count_property.description: Absolute maximum or minimum number of volumes. Range 0 to 2147483647.

vrs_action_property.description: Action DFSMSrmm takes when the threshold is reached.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: Partitioning tape volumes: PRTITION
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description: Use the PRTITION command to identify special processing for DFSMSrmm to perform during library entry, export/import, eject, CUA, OPEN, and EXPROC processing.

volume.title: Volume : VOLUME(ABC*)
volume.description: Select volumes to be managed by this command.

volume_range.title: Volume Range : VOLUMERANGE('ABC000':'ABC999')
volume_range.description: Select a subset of volumes based on starting and ending volser.

type.title: TYPE : TYPE(ALL | RMM | NORMM)
type.description: Identifies the type of volumes selected by the PRTITION command.

system_managed_tape.title: SMT : SMT(ACCEPT | IGNORE)
system_managed_tape.description: Use the SMT operand to select the action for system-managed volumes.

no_system_managed_tape.title: NOSMT(ACCEPT | (ACCEPT LOCATION(...)) | IGNORE)
no_system_managed_tape.description: Use the NOSMT operand to select the action for non-system-managed volumes.

location.title: LOCATION(SHELF | LocdefHome)
location.description: Specifies the location for NOSMT NORMM volumes with action ACCEPT.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: ALLOC
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description: Define installation defaults for unit names, space attributes, TIOT size, handling allocation requests, catalogue error policies. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=sys1parmlib-allocxx-allocation-system-defaults

space_definitions.description: (SPACE) Specifies the installation defaults for space allocation parameters. The defaults only apply to dynamic allocation and VIO requests. When SPACE is specified at least one of the optional subparameters must be specified.

primary.description: (PRIMARY) Specifies the number of units to be allocated

secondary.description: (SECONDARY) Specifies the number of units to be allocated if more space is needed

directory.description: (DIRECTORY) Specifies the number of 256-byte records that are needed in the directory of a PDS

measure.description: (MEASURE) Specifies the unit of measure of the space allocation

block_length.description: (BLKLNGTH) Specifies, in bytes, the average block length of the data.

round.description: (ROUND|NOROUND) When MEASURE(AVEBLK) is specified, requests whether (ROUND) or (NOROUND).

primary_organization.description: (PRIM_ORG) Specifies the organization of the primary space allocation

release_unused_space.description: (RLSE|NORLSE) Requests whether or not unused allocated space is released when data set is closed.

unit_definitions.description: (UNIT) Specifies the installation default for the device on which the system is to place data sets. When UNIT is specified at least one of the optional subparameters must be specified.

name.description: Requests a group of devices to place data sets on

unit_affinity.description: Requests a group of devices to place data sets on, when certain conditions are true. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=defaults-statements-parameters-allocxx

treat_redirected_tape_as.description: (REDIRECTED_TAPE) Allows the installation to specify whether unopened batch-allocated DASD data sets that were redirected from tape should be treated as DASD or TAPE.

task_input_output_table.description: (TIOT) Specifies the installation defaults for the task I/O table

table_size.description: (SIZE) Specifies the size of the task I/O table.

wait_for_special_files.description: (SDSN_WAIT) Specifies the installation policy for batch jobs that must wait to enqueue on special types of data set names.

wait_for_special_data_set_allocation.description: (WAITALLOC) Specifies whether to cancel jobs that must wait to enqueue on the following types of data set names: GDG absolute generation data set name, Real data set name

volume_enqueue_policy.description: (VOLUME_ENQ) Specifies the installation policy for enqueuing on volumes when an allocation request has to wait for a volume or a series of volumes.

action.description: (POLICY) Specifies the default action to take. An installation exit can override the policy.

volume_mount_policy.description: (VOLUME_MNT) Specifies the installation policy for mounting a volume when an allocation request requires a volume to be mounted.

action.description: (POLICY) Specifies the default action to take. The IEF_VOLUME_MNT installation exit can override the policy.

special_volume_wait_policy.description: (SPEC_WAIT) Specifies the installation policy to be followed when an allocation request must wait for a specific volume or unit. When SPEC_WAIT is specified, at least one of the optional subparameters must be specified.

action.description: (POLICY) Specifies the default action to take. The IEF_VOLUME_MNT installation exit can override the policy.

maximum_wait_decision_tries.description: (MAXNWAIT) Specifies the number of WAITNOH decisions that are allowed to be made for the specific volume or unit allocation request before the default that is specified on the POLICYNW parameter takes effect.

action_if_wait_isnt_allowed.description: (POLICYNW) Specifies how the system should handle the allocation request when the system does not allow the job to wait for resources, or when the number of WAITNOH decisions is exceeded.

allocate_offline_policy.description: (ALLC_OFFLN) Specifies the installation policy to be followed when an allocation request must wait for a specific volume or unit. When SPEC_WAIT is specified, at least one of the optional subparameters must be specified.

action.description: (POLICY) Specifies the default action to take. The IEF_VOLUME_MNT installation exit can override the policy.

maximum_wait_decision_tries.description: (MAXNWAIT) Specifies the number of WAITNOH decisions that are allowed to be made for the specific volume or unit allocation request before the default that is specified on the POLICYNW parameter takes effect.

action_if_wait_isnt_allowed.description: (POLICYNW) Specifies how the system should handle the allocation request when the system does not allow the job to wait for resources, or when the number of WAITNOH decisions is exceeded.

catalog_error_actions.description: (CATLG_ERR) Specifies the installation policy for handling certain types of errors that might occur when the system processes the disposition of batch deallocated data sets.

fail_active_job.description: (FAILJOB) Specifies whether the system is to terminate the job if one of the preceding errors occurs.

write_error_message_to_console.description: (ERRORMSG) Specifies whether the system is to issue an error message to the operator if one of the preceding errors occurs.

two_digit_date_policy.description: (2DGT_EXPDT) Identifies the action to be taken if a new data set allocation request specifies a two-digit year (yyddd) Expiration Date.

verify_volume_policy.description: (VERIFY_VOL) Specifies the installation policy for verifying premounted or PASSed/RETAINed volumes on AutoSwitchable (AS) tape devices.

action.description: (POLICY) Specifies whether the system is to perform volume verification of an apparently premounted or PASSed/RETAINed AS tape device at open time.

system_definitions.description: (SYSTEM) Specifies the system defaults. When SYSTEM is specified at least one of the optional subparameters must be specified.

recall_mvs_files_from_archive_before_del.description: (IEFBR14_DELMIGDS) Specifies the policy on whether to recall a migrated data set when you use an IEFBR14 JCL program with DD DISP=(x,DELETE) to delete the data set. The recall is, in most cases, unnecessary, as the data set is being deleted anyway.

tape_library_request_preferences.description: (TAPELIB_PREF) Specifies the policy for balancing nonspecific tape library requests (for example, scratch tape requests) across multiple tape libraries.

time_to_wait_between_reminder_messages.description: (REMIND_INTV) This interval indicates how many seconds between reminder messages, or 0 to disable them. Specifies the number of seconds for how often the message IEF882E and IEF883E are displayed, letting an operator know of an outstanding IEF238D, IEF433D, or IEF434D message.

temporary_mvs_file_name_format.description: (TEMPDSFORMAT) Specifies how the system generates data set names for temporary data sets that include &&label as the specified data set name.

mvs_file_retrival_failure_action.description: (VERIFY_UNCAT) Specifies the policy for handling UNCATLG requests in JCL and dynamic allocation when the data set information is not retrieved from the catalog.

use_memory_based_enqueue_management.description: (MEMDSENQMGMT) Specifies whether the MEMDSENQMGMT feature is available for exploitation by jobs and subsystems.

migrated_mvs_file_recall_mode.description: (BATCH_RCLMIGDS) Specifies how migrated data sets are recalled.

use_separate_dd_statements_for_multi_vol.description: (OPTCDB_SPLIT) Specifies how Allocation should process requests for data sets whose volumes reside in one or more system-managed tape libraries when DCB=OPTCD=B is specified.

scheduler_work_block_storage_type.description: (SWBSTORAGE) Defines whether Scheduler Work Blocks (SWBs) for dynamically allocated data sets are eligible to be placed in 64-bit storage.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: Defining pools: VLPOOL
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description: Use the VLPOOL command to define pools and to set release actions for all volumes in the pool.

prefix.title: PREFIX(nnnnn*)
prefix.description: Specifies a generic shelf location. A pool prefix is one to five characters followed by an asterisk, or a single asterisk for the default pool.

type.title: Type of pool : TYPE(S|R)
type.description: Specifies the type of pool. R for a rack pool, S for a scratch pool.

system_id.title: System identifier : SYSID(system_name)
system_id.description: Associates the scratch pool with a particular system. Specify a value one to eight characters long.

description.title: DESCRIPTION('c.....c')
description.description: Describes the pool. Specify a description between 1 and 32 characters.

racf.title: RACF tape support : RACF(Y|N)
racf.description: Specifies the type of RACF tape support for volumes in the pool.

expdtcheck.title: Expiration date checking option : EXPDTCHECK(Y|N|O)
expdtcheck.description: Specifies to automate the processing of unexpired tape data sets at the pool level.

auto_scratch.title: Scratch processing indicator : AUTOSCRATCH(YES|NO)
auto_scratch.description: Use this operand to override the scratch processing release action for volumes in this pool.

master_overwrite.title: Master volume overwrite control : MASTEROVERWRITE(ADD|LAST|MATCH|USER)
master_overwrite.description: Controls how DFSMSrmm allows the overwriting of a volume in this pool.

name.title: Pool name : NAME(pool_name)
name.description: Specifies a pool name that DFSMSrmm uses to update operator messages and tape drive displays.

release_action.title: NOTIFY release action : RELEASEACTION(NOTIFY)
release_action.description: Use this operand with the NOTIFY value to automatically set the NOTIFY release action for all volumes in this pool.

media_name_array.title: Media type identifier : MEDIANAME(media_name)
media_name_array.description: Specifies a media name. Accepts a list of media names or * for any.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: DFSMShsm ARCCMDxx SETSYS commands for automatic secondary space management functions
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description:
(SETSYS) DFSMShsm SETSYS parameters controlling the automatic space management environment. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=dsar-setsys-command-establishing-changing-values-dfsmshsm-control-parameters
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.$comment:
(SECONDARYSPMGMTDIRECTIVE) Defining parameters and subparameters affecting DFSMShsm automatic space management functions. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=parameters-setsys-fast-path-dfsmshsm-functions

max_tasks_secondary_space_management.description:
(MAXSSMTASKS) Specifying the maximum number of concurrent automatic secondary space management tasks. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxssmtasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-automatic-secondary-space-management-tasks

cleanup.description:
(CLEANUP(tasks)) Specifies the maximum number of secondary space management migration cleanup tasks that can run concurrently. For tasks, specify a decimal number from 0 to 15. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxssmtasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-automatic-secondary-space-management-tasks

tape_movement.description:
(TAPEMOVEMENT(tasks)) specifies the maximum number of automatic secondary space management tape migration tasks that can be run concurrently. This parameter applies to the migration of data sets from level 1 volumes to level 2 tape volumes. or tasks, specify a decimal number from 0 to 15. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxssmtasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-automatic-secondary-space-management-tasks

empty_container_deletion.description:
(EMPTYCONTAINERDELETION(tasks) Specifies the number of cloud storage containers processing tasks. Only 0 or 1 values are acceptable. A value of 0 indicates that cloud storage containers deletion task will not be submitted. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxssmtasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-automatic-secondary-space-management-tasks

migration_cleanup_days.description:
(MIGRATIONCLEANUPDAYS) Specifying the number of days to keep MCDS data set records and statistics records. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-migrationcleanupdays-specifying-number-days-keep-mcds-data-set-records-statistics-records

recall_days.description:
(recall_days) Specify a decimal number from 0 to 999 for the number of days since the date of recall that DFSMShsm keeps MCDS data set records for recalled data sets. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-migrationcleanupdays-specifying-number-days-keep-mcds-data-set-records-statistics-records

statistics_days.description:
(statistics_days) Specify a decimal number from 1 to 999 for the number of days DFSMShsm keeps the daily and volume statistics records. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-migrationcleanupdays-specifying-number-days-keep-mcds-data-set-records-statistics-records

reconnect_days.description:
(reconnect_days) Specify a decimal number from 0 to 999 for the number of days that DFSMShsm uses to calculate how long to keep the MCDS data set records for recalled data sets that are candidates for reconnection. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-migrationcleanupdays-specifying-number-days-keep-mcds-data-set-records-statistics-records

cloud_days.description:
(cloud_days) Specifies a decimal number from 0 to 999 for the number of days that DFSMShsm should keep old cloud migration copies around after a modified version of the same data set has been remigrated to the cloud. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-migrationcleanupdays-specifying-number-days-keep-mcds-data-set-records-statistics-records

secondary_space_management_directive.description:
(SECONDARYSPMGMTDIRECTIVE(ALL|CLOUDONLY|NOCLOUD) Specifying secondary space management controls pertaining to Cloud and non-Cloud data. 
 Specify (ALL) to direct secondary space management to process data regardless of where it resides. 
 Specify (CLOUDONLY) to direct secondary space management to process data residing in cloud object store. 
 Specify (NOCLOUD) to direct secondary space management not to process any data residing in the cloud object store and not run empty container deletion. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-secondaryspmgmtdirective-specifying-secondary-space-management-controls-pertaining-cloud-non-cloud-data

ssm_planned_start_time.description:
(hhmm1) Specifies the planned start time for automatic secondary space management. If hhmm1 is set to 0000, secondary space management will not start. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-secondaryspmgmtstart-specifying-start-stop-time-automatic-secondary-space-management

ssm_planned_stop_time.description:
(hhmm2) Specifies planned stop time for automatic secondary space management. If hhmm2 is set to zero, this is the same as not including the hhmm2 parameter. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-secondaryspmgmtstart-specifying-start-stop-time-automatic-secondary-space-management

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.title: DFSMShsm ARCCMDxx SETSYS commands for dump function
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description:
(SETSYS) DFSMShsm SETSYS parameters that controlling dump function, including: 
  - 'automatic_dump_timing': Specifying when automatic dump is to start. 
  - 'max_dump_tasks': Specifying the maximum number of volume dump tasks DFSMShsm can concurrently process. 
  - 'dump_volume_concurrent_copy_option':  Specifying whether DFSMShsm will request that DFSMSdss use a type of Concurrent Copy function for dump volumes or no Concurrent Copy function for dump volumes.

automatic_dump_timing.description:
(AUTODUMPSTART) Specifying when automatic dump is to start, including: 
  - 'first_start': (hhmm1) is the time you plan for DFSMShsm to start automatic dump. 
  - 'latest_start': (hhmm2) is the latest time DFSMShsm can start automatic dump. 
  - 'no_start_additional_volume': (hhmm3) is the time after which DFSMShsm will not start automatic dump on additional volumes. 
 'first_start' is required. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-autodumpstart-specifying-when-automatic-dump-is-start

first_start.description:
(hhmm1) is the time you plan for DFSMShsm to start automatic dump. Time is based on the 24-hour clock and is expressed as a four-digit decimal number in the format hhmm. 
 The maximum value you can specify for hh is 24, the maximum value you can specify for mm is 59, and the maximum value you can specify for hhmm is 2400.

latest_start.description:
(hhmm2) is the latest time DFSMShsm can start automatic dump. Time is based on the 24-hour clock and is expressed as a four-digit decimal number in the format hhmm. 
 The maximum value you can specify for hh is 24, the maximum value you can specify for mm is 59, and the maximum value you can specify for hhmm is 2400. If you do not specify a value for hhmm2, the SETSYS default is 2400.

no_start_additional_volume.description:
(hhmm3) is the time after which DFSMShsm will not start automatic dump on additional volumes. Time is based on the 24-hour clock and is expressed as a four-digit decimal number in the format hhmm. 
 The maximum value you can specify for hh is 24, the maximum value you can specify for mm is 59, and the maximum value you can specify for hhmm is 2400.

max_tasks_dump.description:
(MAXDUMPTASKS) Specifying the maximum number of volume dump tasks DFSMShsm can concurrently process (0-64). 
 If you do not specify this parameter on any SETSYS command, the DFSMShsm default is two tasks. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxdumptasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-volume-dump-tasks

dump_volume_concurrent_copy_option.description:
(VOLUMEDUMP) Specifying whether DFSMShsm will request that DFSMSdss use a type of Concurrent Copy function for dump volumes or no Concurrent Copy function for dump volumes. Its value can be either a 'false' boolean value or a string for a specific concurrent copy option. 
  - false: Indicates Concurrent Copy will not be used when DFSMShsm dumps the volumes. It equals to specify the concurrent copy option as 'STANDARD' or 'NOCC'. 
  - CC: DFSMShsm specifies Concurrent Copy when DFSMSdss dumps volumes. DFSMSdss determines if the device and microcode can support this operation. Customers can specify SETSYS DUMPVOLUME(CC). CC is an alias of PREFERRED and can be added next to the word PREFERRED like the other aliases. 
  - STANDARD | NOCC: STANDARD indicates Concurrent Copy will not be used when DFSMShsm dumps the volumes. Control returns to the requestor at the end of the physical copy. 
  - PREFERRED | ANYPREFERRED: DFSMShsm requests DFSMSdss to use concurrent copy to perform the dump. If virtual concurrent copy is unavailable, DFSMSdss uses cache-based concurrent copy. If both types of concurrent copy are unavailable, the dump continues as if the CC keyword was not specified. 
  - REQUIRED | ANYREQUIRED: DFSMShsm requests DFSMSdss to use concurrent copy to perform the dump. If virtual concurrent copy is unavailable DFSMSdss uses cache-based concurrent copy. If both types of concurrent copy are unavailable, the dump fails. 
  - CACHEPREFERRED | CPREF: DFSMShsm requests DFSMSdss to use cache-based concurrent copy to dump the data sets. If cache-based concurrent copy is unavailable, the data set dump continues as if the CC keyword was not specified. 
  - VIRTUALPREFERRED | VPREF: DFSMShsm requests DFSMSdss to use virtual concurrent copy to dump volumes. If virtual concurrent copy is unavailable, the dump continues as if the CC keyword was not specified. 
  - CACHEREQUIRED | CREQ: DFSMShsm requests DFSMSdss to use cache-based concurrent copy to dump the data sets. If cache-based concurrent copy is unavailable, the dump fails. 
  - VIRTUALREQUIRED | VREQ: DFSMShsm requests DFSMSdss to use virtual concurrent copy to dump volumes. If virtual concurrent copy is unavailable, the dump fails. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-volumedump-specifying-concurrent-copy-options-dump-volumes

max_tasks_dataset_recover.description:
(MAXDSRECOVERTASKS) Controlling the data set recovery environment. MAXDSRECOVERTASKS(max_tasks)is an optional parameter specifying the maximum number of data set recovery tasks DFSMShsm can concurrently process for both DASD and tape. This parameter allows an installation to determine the appropriate tasking level to recover individual data sets based on the amount of disk storage and the number of tape drive resources available. The actual number of effective tasks might be limited if the number of backup resources is less than the total tasks specified. For max_tasks, substitute with a decimal number from 1 to 64 to represent the number of data set recovery tasks to be run concurrently. The default is 2 tasks. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxdsrecovertasks-specifying-maximum-number-data-set-recovery-tasks-from-dasd-tape

max_tasks_dataset_recover_from_tape.description:
(MAXDSTAPERECOVERTASKS) Controlling the data set recovery environment. MAXDSTAPERECOVERTASKS(max_tasks)is an optional parameter specifying the maximum number of data set recovery tasks DFSMShsm can concurrently process from tape. This parameter allows an installation to determine the appropriate tasking level to recover individual data sets based on the number of tape drive resources available. The actual number of effective tasks might be limited if the number of backup tape drives is less than the total tasks specified. For max_tasks, substitute with a decimal number from 0 to 64 to represent the number of data set recovery from tape tasks to be run concurrently. When MAXDSTAPERECOVERTASKS(max_tasks) is not specified, the default is the max_tasks value specified in the MAXDSRECOVERTASK(max_tasks). 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxdstaperecovertasks-specifying-maximum-number-data-set-recovery-tasks-from-tape

max_tasks_volume_recover_from_dump.description:
(MAXDUMPRECOVERTASKS) Controlling the volume recovery environment. MAXDUMPRECOVERTASKS(max_tasks) is an optional parameter specifying the maximum number of volume recovery from dump tasks DFSMShsm can concurrently process. The dump can reside on tape or cloud object store. This parameter allows you to set the appropriate tasking level to recover individual volumes based on the number of tape drives. The actual number of effective tasks will be limited by the number of tape drives available and dump stacking value. For max_tasks, specify a decimal number from 0 to 64 to represent the number of volume recovery from dump tasks to be processed concurrently. The default is 1 task. 
 https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=opsc-maxdumprecovertasks-specifying-maximum-number-concurrent-volume-recovery-from-dump-tasks

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Dat.description:
(TRAP) Requesting a dump when a specified error occurs. The TRAP command specifies what DFSMShsm should do when a specified error condition occurs in a specified module or in all modules.
https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=commands-maintenance-command-trap

all_modules.description:
(ALL) Specifies that you want to test all DFSMShsm modules for errors.
https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-all-module-specifying-location-trap

module_name.description:
(module) The name of the DFSMShsm module that you want to test for errors. The module name can be 1 to 8 characters.
https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-all-module-specifying-location-trap

error_code.description:
(error code) An optional positional parameter specifying the error return code to be tested when it is returned by the module you specify. If you substitute a zero for the error code, DFSMShsm tests for any error in the specified module.
https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-error-code-specifying-error-code-test

ABEND.description:
(ABEND) Specifies that DFSMShsm abnormally ends the task when the specified error condition occurs in the specified module. DFSMShsm abnormally ends the task by issuing an ABEND macro. Can be specified alone or with a parameter (ALWAYS, NEVER, ONCE).
https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=optc-abend-log-off-snap-specifying-what-dfsmshsm-should-do-if-error-occurs

LOG.description:
(LOG) Specifies that you want DFSMShsm to write an entry in the DFSMShsm log when the specified error condition occurs in the specified module. TRAP LOG avoids DFSMShsm shutdown because the errors do not increment the counter for the maximum number of occurrences.
https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=optc-abend-log-off-snap-specifying-what-dfsmshsm-should-do-if-error-occurs

OFF.description:
(OFF) Specifies that you want DFSMShsm to remove a trap that you specified with a previous TRAP command. This command returns DFSMShsm to the process level that IBM previously specified.
https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=optc-abend-log-off-snap-specifying-what-dfsmshsm-should-do-if-error-occurs

SNAP.description:
(SNAP) Specifies that you want DFSMShsm to produce a snap dump when the specified error condition occurs in the specified module. DFSMShsm produces a snap dump by issuing a SNAP macro. DFSMShsm continues processing after producing a snap dump. Can be specified alone or with a parameter (ALWAYS, NEVER, ONCE).
https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=optc-abend-log-off-snap-specifying-what-dfsmshsm-should-do-if-error-occurs
